data.overview: MERIT is a modern "clean beauty" brand founded in 2021, selling minimalist makeup and clinically-proven skincare, with teams in New York, Los Angeles, Toronto, London, and Paris. Independent cruelty-free trackers (Bunny Search, citing Ethical Elephant and Leaping Bunny) report MERIT is Leaping Bunny certified and offers vegan products. Good On You rates MERIT overall "Not good enough," scoring it low on planet and people but top marks on animals.

claims.claim: MERIT states its skincare formulas are clinically proven to cleanse, treat, and moisturize.
claims.quote: Skincare Clinically proven formulas designed to cleanse, treat, and moisturize — in three steps.

papers.title: Merit Beauty - Sustainability Rating
papers.summary: Good On You gives Merit Beauty an overall rating of 'Not good enough,' scoring it 1 out of 5 on both planet and people, but 5 out of 5 on animals. The rating was last updated in September 2024, and a detailed rating summary is noted as forthcoming.
